method.description: Actual source and all chronological contact sheets inspected using view_image. Evenly spaced frames include 0, 4 and last. CPU FFmpeg decoding, filtering and PNG encoding limited to two threads each; no GPU or generation submission.

observations: The actual source shows a recognizable face-free tent, rolled mat and lantern with broad red, yellow, turquoise, blue, purple, green and orange components.

Across 32 chronological samples, the turquoise entrance flaps gently change curvature and opening width while the tent ridge and outer panels stay coherent. Motion is restrained but visible; no sudden collapse or panel loss is observed.
The green rolled mat, orange strap and blue/yellow lantern persist from frame 0 through frame 123. Lantern shape shifts slightly without developing eyes or a mouth; all props remain recognizable.
The full composition stays within the frame without accumulating drift or sampled clipping. Source colours and the dark-blue/purple interior remain consistent.
limitations: Sampled still-frame inspection, not real-time playback or inspection of every frame. Motion observations describe progression across samples; frame-perfect smoothness, inter-sample artifacts and seamless looping are not guaranteed.
Contact sheets use reduced-size frames; full-resolution extracted samples are retained beside them.
scope: Exact-source and exact-video sampled visual reward-video review only. No painting processing, build, emulator, imports or integration performed or approved.
